name: c-questionnaire-1
title: Guided workspace setup
label: Guided Setup
description: Three required questions in a card, with progress, navigation and a summary on submit.

guidance.bestFor: The baseline card flow of single answer questions, each choice carrying a hint line and a letter key shortcut
agentNotes: Edit `QUESTIONS` only; `ITEMS` is derived from it, including the choice values the letter shortcuts are assigned from
Each `QuestionnaireItem` points `aria-labelledby` at its title `id`, because the `CardHeader` in between leaves the fieldset unnamed

whenNotToUse.when: A question where the visitor may tick several answers at once

name: c-questionnaire-2
title: Multi-select answers
label: Multi-Select
description: A checkbox question that accepts several answers, with a live count and a chip summary.

guidance.bestFor: A bare flow with no Card that opens on a 6 option checkbox question, its ticked count shown in a Badge by the counter
agentNotes: The `selected` count is host state fed by each choice `onChange`, so clear it alongside the answers as `startOver` does
Read the ticked workflows with `formData.getAll`, which returns one entry per checked box rather than a joined string

whenNotToUse.when: A long option list that needs a search box before several values are picked

name: c-questionnaire-3
title: A written answer beside the choices
label: Write-In Answer
description: A text input sitting with the fixed choices, so an answer can be typed instead of picked.

guidance.bestFor: A write-in row with its own visible Label that clears the picked radio as you type and submits under the question name
agentNotes: Pass your own `id` to `QuestionnaireInput` so the `Label` `htmlFor` finds it; a passed id wins over the generated one
The typed answer posts under the same `name` as the radios, so `answerLabel` treats a value matching no option as the write-in

whenNotToUse.when: A write-in on a question the visitor may also decline
A step asking for a long free text reply, a date or a file

name: c-questionnaire-4
title: Segmented progress with step labels
label: Segmented Progress
description: A custom progress bar built from the progress render state, over a four question flow.

guidance.bestFor: A bare flow whose counter is redrawn as filled segments with a named step, ending on an Empty success state
agentNotes: Keep `w-full` on `QuestionnaireProgress`, which ships `w-fit` with a minimum width sized for its default text
`aria-valuetext` is set after the `props` spread so the step label replaces the built in Question N of M announcement

whenNotToUse.when: Segments that track a task or checklist with no question behind each one
Named steps the visitor clicks to jump straight to any one

name: c-questionnaire-5
title: An optional question with skip
label: Optional Skip
description: A question the visitor may skip on purpose, with the skipped state carried into the summary.

guidance.bestFor: A status Badge over the card tracking the optional middle question, which also takes a write-in, as not answered, answered or skipped
agentNotes: The middle question is optional because its `ITEMS` entry and its `QuestionnaireItem` both leave out `required`; Skip shows only there
`watchStatus` mirrors `onStatusChange` because `FormData` cannot tell skipped from blank; `startOver` has to reset it

whenNotToUse.when: A question that only applies after a particular earlier answer

name: c-questionnaire-6
title: A rule that sends you back
label: Cross-Question Rule
description: A cross-question rule checked on submit, returning the flow to the question that broke it.

guidance.bestFor: Controlled step position that a failed submit check moves back, with custom error copy holding Next until the plan or region changes
agentNotes: Replace the `self-managed` and `starter` check in `handleSubmit` and its `PLAN_CONFLICT` copy with your own cross question rule
Each region and plan choice clears `planError` in its `onChange`, since a set `invalid` flag keeps blocking Next

whenNotToUse.when: Checks that each question can settle alone, with no rule across two answers

name: c-questionnaire-7
title: A branch that appears when it applies
label: Conditional Branch
description: A question that only joins the flow after an earlier answer, with avatars, reset and a summary.

guidance.bestFor: A controlled first question whose answer enables a people picker step, taking the counter from 3 to 4 questions
agentNotes: Toggle `disabled` only on an item after the controlling question; disabling the one on screen sends the visitor back to the first
A form reset leaves host state alone, so `onReset` clears `usage` or the owner step stays in the flow
Replace `OWNERS` with your people; each `photo` is a 96px square crop hosted on Unsplash
